rows.grounds: imperative of root sthā, second person singular active
present participle, nominative singular masculine, from root krīḍ

items.question: What conduct is prescribed for the goddess within the inner apartment?
premises: The addressee is commanded to stay.
The prescribed location is the inner apartment.
The prescribed activity is playing with gods.
items.inference: The verse prescribes secluded divine play in the inner apartment.
uncertainties: The exact addressee and ritual context are not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: You stay in the inner apartment, playing with groups of gods.
